facts.text: The hotel is a Beaux Arts landmark atop Nob Hill.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont San Francisco is a 5-star luxury hotel and iconic Beaux Arts landmark atop Nob Hill.

facts.text: Guestrooms and suites are split between a historic Main Building and a contemporary Tower.
facts.excerpt: guestrooms and suites across our historic Main Building and contemporary Tower

facts.text: Fairmont 2 Queen rooms in the main building have 14-ft vaulted ceilings and windows that open, with city or interior views.
facts.excerpt: these guestrooms boast 14-ft vaulted ceilings, windows that open with city or interior views

facts.text: Signature Bay View rooms have Bay views through large picture windows, with landmarks including Alcatraz, Coit Tower and the Golden Gate Bridge.
facts.excerpt: Expansive views include landmarks such as Alcatraz, Coit Tower, and the Golden Gate Bridge.

facts.text: Signature Bay View Suites are on floors 2-9 and have large picture windows and telescopes.
facts.excerpt: Located on floors 2-9, these contemporary suites offer stunning Bay views through large picture windows and telescopes.

facts.text: The Tony Bennett Suite pays homage to Tony Bennett, who first performed his signature tune in the hotel in 1961.
facts.excerpt: This Legacy Suite pays homage to the legendary Tony Bennett who first performed the signature tune in the hotel in 1961.

facts.text: The Tony Bennett Suite is on the 22nd floor and features artwork by Tony Bennett and panoramic Bay views.
facts.excerpt: Perched on the 22nd floor, it features artwork by Mr. Bennett and panoramic Bay views.

facts.text: The Penthouse spans the entire 8th floor and has a library, billiards room and outdoor terrace with skyline and Bay views.
facts.excerpt: living room with fireplace, formal dining, kitchen, library, billiards room and outdoor terrace with skyline and Bay views.

facts.text: Family Rooms in the main building can accommodate up to 6 adults.
facts.excerpt: These spacious rooms in the main building feature 14-ft vaulted ceilings, and can accommodate up to 6 adults.

facts.text: The One Bedroom Suite with balcony has French doors leading to a balcony overlooking the rooftop garden.
facts.excerpt: French doors lead to a grand balcony overlooking the rooftop garden.

facts.text: The hotel has a rooftop garden with a fountain and views of the city.
facts.excerpt: has a rooftop garden with a fountain and views of the city

facts.text: The hotel has its own beehives and allows pets.
facts.excerpt: The hotel has its own beehives, allows pets

facts.text: The Tonga Room & Hurricane Bar serves tiki cocktails and pu pu platters.
facts.excerpt: the kitsch tiki cocktails and pu pu platters of the iconic Tonga Room & Hurricane Bar

facts.text: Laurel Court is a dining room serving breakfast, lunch and dinner under high ceilings and chandeliers.
facts.excerpt: Laurel Court, dining room where breakfast, lunch, and dinner are served under soaring ceilings and chandeliers

facts.text: Afternoon Tea at the hotel has been a tradition since 1907.
facts.excerpt: Afternoon Tea, a Fairmont San Francisco tradition since 1907

facts.text: Overnight valet parking for guests carries a fee.
facts.excerpt: Overnight valet parking for guests is $90 + tax.

facts.text: Fairmont 1 Queen rooms are interior rooms in the historic main building.
facts.excerpt: Nestled in the historic main building, these interior Queen guestrooms feature high ceilings, spacious closets and bathrooms.
